# 1687. Delivering Boxes from Storage to Ports

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
# Dynamic programming
class Solution(object):
    def boxDelivering(self, boxes, portsCount, maxBoxes, maxWeight):
        """
        :type boxes: List[List[int]]
        :type portsCount: int
        :type maxBoxes: int
        :type maxWeight: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        n = len(boxes)
        dp = [0] + [float("inf")] * n
        j, lastj, need = 0, 0, 0
        for i in range(n):
            while j < n and maxBoxes > 0 and maxWeight >= boxes[j][1]:
                maxBoxes -= 1
                maxWeight -= boxes[j][1]
                if j == 0 or boxes[j][0] != boxes[j - 1][0]:
                    lastj = j
                    need += 1
                j += 1
            dp[j] = min(dp[j], dp[i] + need + 1)
            dp[lastj] = min(dp[lastj], dp[i] + need)
            maxBoxes += 1
            maxWeight += boxes[i][1] 
            if i == n - 1 or boxes[i][0] != boxes[i + 1][0]:
                need -= 1
        return dp[-1]
```
